scripts.build: pnpm run cartographer:catalog && pnpm run metatiles:catalog && turbo run build
scripts.e2e: pnpm run cartographer:catalog && pnpm run metatiles:catalog && turbo run e2e
scripts.cartographer:ui: pnpm run cartographer:catalog && pnpm run metatiles:catalog && pnpm --filter @wayfarer/ui run dev
scripts.cartographer:catalog: pnpm --filter @wayfarer/cartographer run build && pnpm exec wcartographer --catalog --output build/cartographer/map-catalog
scripts.metatiles:catalog: pnpm --filter @wayfarer/metatiles run build && pnpm exec wmetatiles --output build/cartographer/map-catalog/metatiles
